name: interpretability-starter
description: 🧠 Starter templates for doing interpretability research

paragraphs: Interpretability research is an exciting and growing field of machine learning. If we are able to understand what happens within neural networks in diverse domains, we can see why the network gives us specific outputs and detect deception, understand choices, and change how they work.

This list of resources was made for the Interpretability Hackathon (link) and contains an array of useful starter templates, tools to investigate model activations, and a number of introductory resources. Check out aisi.ai for some ideas for projects within ML & AI safety.
